# ApexLogics — Deterministic Decision Engines for People, Creators, and Agents
# https://apexlogics.org
# Publisher: Post Oak Labs — https://postoaklabs.com
# Sister suites: AINumbers.co (markets & institutions) — https://ainumbers.co · OpenChainScience (science & evidence)
# License: CC BY 4.0
# Policy Mandate Protocol: OpenChainGraph decision-record (org.apexlogics namespace) — not Google's Agent Payments Protocol, which ApexLogics tools do not emit
# Suite version: registry v5.6.6 · spec v10.9 · contract v1.12.1
# Last updated: 2026-09-03
# Tools: 175 shipped · 111 showcase exemplars · 0 deferred · 0 proposed
# Privacy: Zero PII. All computation client-side. No accounts, no tracking.

## Summary

ApexLogics is deterministic decision engines for people, creators, and agents: 175 browser-based tools covering career and education economics, including credential ROI, education financing, compensation analysis, career transitions, licensing, workforce development, immigration, equity tax, and freelance tax planning. Every tool is a single self-contained HTML file with zero network calls after load and zero PII collection. All tools emit Policy Mandates (JSON) and Markdown reports for agent and human handoff. 40 multi-tool workflows chain tools into end-to-end decision journeys at /workflows/. 9 guides at /guides/.

## How to Use This File

Each tool entry below gives: display number, AL-ID, title, URL, one-line description, Policy Mandate type emitted, and downstream handoff candidates. Full machine-readable metadata (tags, personas, journeys, data vintage): https://apexlogics.org/suite-registry.json

## OpenChainGraph (machine-readable discovery)

ApexLogics conforms to the OpenChainGraph Standard v0.8.8 (https://postoaklabs.github.io/chaingraph/). Every tool emits a hash-anchored, chainable Policy Mandate artifact carrying a verifiable SHA-256 execution_hash over canonical {policy_parameters, output_payload}, and captures an inbound parent artifact via the ?ap2= handoff for runtime chaining (chain.parent_hashes). Namespace: org.apexlogics. chaingraph_version is the single version anchor; the legacy ap2_mandate_type field is retained per-artifact as a deprecated alias, and the ap2_version field has been retired ("Policy Mandate" is the OCG decision-record type — not Google's Agent Payments Protocol, which ApexLogics tools do not emit).
- Graph index (every node's mandate_type + consumes/feeds chain edges): https://apexlogics.org/chaingraph/chaingraph.json
- A2A agent card (declares the x-chaingraph extension): https://apexlogics.org/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Independent hash verification (MCP tool): verify_execution_hash at https://mcp.apexlogics.org/mcp

### #172 · AL-186 — Lurking-Variable Reversal Detector
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/172-lurking-variable-reversal-detector/
Paste your own stratified 2x2 table (any number of strata, custom group/outcome/stratum labels) to get per-stratum odds ratios, the crude pooled odds ratio, the Mantel-Haenszel (1959) adjusted odds ratio, and an explicit reversal flag when the aggregate and stratified stories disagree. Berkeley 1973 six-department admissions data ships built in as the worked example.
Policy Mandate type: reversal_detector_record

### #173 · AL-187 — Parallel-Trends & Placebo Checker
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/173-parallel-trends-placebo-checker/
Enter 3 or more pre-treatment periods for a treatment group and a control group to test the parallel-trends assumption behind a difference-in-differences design: a pre-trend slope gap with a t-test, an event-study table of period-by-period treatment-minus-control differences, and an in-time placebo test at a fake treatment date. A classic single pre/post 2x2 tab ships for completeness only.
Policy Mandate type: parallel_trends_record
Handoffs in: AL-88

Policy Mandate type: anticounterfeit_consumer_check_record

### SC-71 — Multi-Party Supply-Chain Interoperability
URL: https://apexlogics.org/showcase/multiparty-supply-chain-interop/
Given up to three party contributions (party id, node output digest, declared parent party), returns party count, digest present count, parent resolution faults, root count, a join digest, a graph-joins flag, and a status. Deterministic, zero external data. Policy Mandate v2.0: multiparty_supply_chain_interop_record.
Policy Mandate type: multiparty_supply_chain_interop_record

### SC-72 — EUDR Due Diligence Statement Validation
URL: https://apexlogics.org/showcase/eudr-dds-validation/
Given an eight element weighted checklist for an EUDR due diligence statement, returns element count, score out of 100, a comma joined list of missing elements, a blocking-missing flag, and a status of filable, blocked, or gaps. Deterministic, zero external data. Policy Mandate v2.0: eudr_dds_validation_record.
Policy Mandate type: eudr_dds_validation_record

### SC-73 — EUDR Supply-Chain Risk and Traceability
URL: https://apexlogics.org/showcase/eudr-supply-chain-risk/
Given total and geolocated plot counts, a country risk tier, supplier tier depth, and a mixed origin flag, returns geolocation coverage and gap in basis points, country risk weight, traceability credit, mixed origin penalty, a risk score out of 100, a risk band, a simplified due diligence eligibility flag, and a status. Deterministic, zero external data. Policy Mandate v2.0: eudr_supply_chain_risk_record.
Policy Mandate type: eudr_supply_chain_risk_record

### SC-74 — C2PA Content Credential Verification
URL: https://apexlogics.org/showcase/content-credential-verification/
Given a credential entered once as signed and once as received (asset title, issuer, capture device, edit actions, content digest), returns fingerprints for each side, a manifest match flag, mutated field names and count, an assertion count, issuer presence, and a status. Deterministic, zero external data. Policy Mandate v2.0: content_credential_verification_record.
Policy Mandate type: content_credential_verification_record

### SC-75 — AI Content Disclosure (AI Act Article 50)
URL: https://apexlogics.org/showcase/ai-content-disclosure-conformance/
Given a content type and five marking checklist items, returns disclosure requirement, disclosure regime (full or reduced), required and satisfied element counts, missing elements, echoed human review documentation, and a conformance status. Deterministic, zero external data. Policy Mandate v2.0: ai_content_disclosure_conformance_record.
Policy Mandate type: ai_content_disclosure_conformance_record

### SC-76 — Deepfake Consumer Verification
URL: https://apexlogics.org/showcase/deepfake-consumer-verification/
Given five yes, no, or unknown answers (credential present, credential matches source, publisher identifiable, disclosure label visible, independent report found), returns a signal total out of 10, unknown and no counts, a confidence band, a checkable-now flag, and a status. Deterministic, zero external data. Policy Mandate v2.0: deepfake_consumer_verification_record.
Policy Mandate type: deepfake_consumer_verification_record

### SC-77 — Cross-Vendor Provenance Interoperability
URL: https://apexlogics.org/showcase/cross-vendor-provenance-interop/
Given three core fields entered twice (asset id, issuer, created day) and two source formats, returns field agreement count, disagreeing field names, a mappable flag, a format pair, a normalized digest, and a status. Deterministic, zero external data. Policy Mandate v2.0: cross_vendor_provenance_interop_record.
Policy Mandate type: cross_vendor_provenance_interop_record

Note: the suite spans two Policy Mandate schema generations — v1.0 (nested mandates, tools #01–#33-era) and v2.0 (flat mandates, tools #29+). Canonical reconciliation lives in the build contract; each tool validates its emitted type before download.

## Technical Constraints (All Tools)

- Single self-contained .html file per tool. No external dependencies post-load.
- Zero network calls. No fetch, XHR, WebWorker, or CDN after page load.
- Zero PII. No storage, logging, or transmission of personal data.
- sessionStorage: apex_lang key only (UI language preference).
- Fonts: Google Fonts (DM Serif Display, Sora, JetBrains Mono) loaded at page open only.
- i18n: EN/ES/FR/AR/PT/Chinese language toggle on every tool.
- Policy Mandate export: JSON + Markdown download. Schema validation runs before any download.
- PII banner: "All inputs are processed locally in your browser. Nothing is transmitted, stored, or logged."
- License: CC BY 4.0. Source readable and attribution-ready.
